key_impacts: Storm surge flooding in New York City exceeded the 100-year floodplain boundaries by 53% citywide.
Approximately 8,500,000 customers lost power at peak during Sandy in the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.
Two refineries—Hess Port Reading (Port Reading, NJ) and Bayway Phillips 66 (Linden, NJ)—were shut down, resulting in the loss of 26.3% of 1,170,200 barrels per day operating capacity.
Gas stations in New Jersey were unable to operate due to power outages.
Three health care facilities in Manhattan and Brooklyn evacuated all patients due to the outage.
